parse.title: Wilderness Diary
parse.wikitext:
===Rewards===
*[[Wilderness sword 4]]:
**Identical stats to an [[adamant sword]] (only weighs negligibly less)
**Unlimited teleports to the [[Fountain of Rune]]
*[[Antique lamp (elite)|Antique lamp]] worth 50,000 experience in any skill of at least level 70
*Free access to the [[Resource Area]], down from a fee of 3,750 [[coins]]
*[[Lundail]] offers you 200 random [[runes]] for free every day, worth a total average of {{NoCoins|{{#var:avgrune}}*200}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
*[[Dragon bones]] from [[dragon]]s killed in the [[Wilderness]] are now [[noted]], unless this feature is disabled by talking to the [[Lesser Fanatic]] in [[Edgeville]] (this excludes the dragon bones of [[King Black Dragon]], as his [[King Black Dragon Lair|lair]] is considered to be outside of the [[Wilderness]])
*Catch rate of [[raw dark crab|dark crabs]] increased by 112.5%
